description.raw: '''Innate - Intent:''' '''Yasuo's''' [[File:Critical strike chance icon.png|15px|link=Critical strike]] '''total''' critical strike chance is doubled from all other sources. Additionally,「 every 1% critical strike chance in excess of 100% is converted into [[File:Attack damage icon.svg|15px|link=Attack damage]] 0.5 '''bonus''' attack damage. 」「 every 50% critical strike chance in excess of 100% is converted into [[File:Attack damage icon.svg|15px|link=Attack damage]] 25 '''bonus''' attack damage. 」
description.text: Innate - Intent: Yasuo's  total critical strike chance is doubled from all other sources. Additionally,「 every 1% critical strike chance in excess of 100% is converted into  0.5 bonus attack damage. 」「 every 50% critical strike chance in excess of 100% is converted into  25 bonus attack damage. 」

description2.raw: '''Yasuo's''' [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critical strikes]] deal only「 (190% + [[File:Infinity Edge item.png|20xpx|border|link=Infinity Edge|An icon for the item Infinity Edge]] [[Infinity Edge|28.5%]]) AD physical damage. 」「 95% of the [[File:Critical strike damage icon.png|15px|link=Critical strike]] critical damage champions usually have. 」
description2.text: Yasuo's critical strikes deal only「 (190% +  28.5%) AD physical damage. 」「 95% of the  critical damage champions usually have. 」

description3.raw: '''Innate - Resolve:''' '''Yasuo''' generates a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of [[File:Flow resource.png|20px|link=Flow|An icon representing the keyword Flow]] [[:Flow|Flow]] for every 59 / 52.5 / 46 (based on level) units he travels by any means. At「 100 stacks 」「 5900 / 5250 / 4600 (based on level) units traveled 」and upon taking damage from an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] or [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]], '''Yasuo''' consumes all [[File:Flow resource.png|20px|link=Flow|An icon representing the keyword Flow]] [[:Flow|Flow]] to grant himself a [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shield]] for 125 – 674.46 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] that lasts for 1 second.
description3.text: Innate - Resolve: Yasuo generates a stack of Flow for every 59 / 52.5 / 46 (based on level) units he travels by any means. At「 100 stacks 」「 5900 / 5250 / 4600 (based on level) units traveled 」and upon taking damage from an enemy champion or monster, Yasuo consumes all Flow to grant himself a shield for 125 – 674.46 (based on level)Category:Debug that lasts for 1 second.

notes.raw: * '''Yasuo''' gains the shield before the damage instance; the shield will mitigate the damage that triggered it. * '''Yasuo''' is able to reach 100% critical strike chance with ''Way of the Wanderer's'' multiplier after obtaining a total of [[File:Critical strike chance icon.png|15px|link=Critical strike]] 50% critical strike chance. * '''Yasuo's''' secondary resource bar will display the amount of shield stored as an equivalent percentage to his Flow stacks. (Each Flow stack will add 1.25 – 6.74 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] to the bar) ** Upon taking damage, the bar will display his current shield strength.
notes.text:
Yasuo gains the shield before the damage instance; the shield will mitigate the damage that triggered it.
Yasuo is able to reach 100% critical strike chance with Way of the Wanderer's multiplier after obtaining a total of  50% critical strike chance.
Yasuo's secondary resource bar will display the amount of shield stored as an equivalent percentage to his Flow stacks. (Each Flow stack will add 1.25 – 6.74 (based on level)Category:Debug to the bar)
* Upon taking damage, the bar will display his current shield strength.
